results.device_name: Atrial Fibrillation Risk Prediction Machine Learning-Based Notification Software
results.definition: Atrial Fibrillation Risk Prediction machine learning-based notification software employs machine learning techniques to suggest the likelihood of a future occurrence of atrial fibrillation for further referral or diagnostic follow-up.

results.device_name: Radiological Software Device To Predict Future Breast Cancer Risk
results.definition: A radiological software device to predict future breast cancer risk is a device that analyzes radiological images generated by breast imaging modalities and/or inputs derived from radiological images to provide qualified healthcare professionals with a prediction of the risk of future (incident) breast cancer. This device produces a numeric probability and/or risk category indicative of the patients future breast cancer risk from the time the analyzed images were acquired. This device is not intended to diagnose, detect, or inform the treatment of cancer. The output of this device is not intended to guide interpretation of imaging exams.

results.device_name: Radiological Software System For Delivery Date Prediction
results.definition: A radiological software system for delivery date prediction is a software-only device that analyzes obstetric radiological images to predict the delivery date of a pregnancy. The device output does not replace a clinician's review or judgment on the progression of a pregnancy and should be used in conjunction with other clinical and diagnostic findings. The device does not identify at-risk pregnancies or identify specific complications.

results.device_name: Software-Aided Adjunctive Diagnostic Device For Use By Physicians On Lesions Suspicious For Skin Cancer
results.definition: A software-aided adjunctive diagnostic device for use by physicians on lesions suspicious for skin cancer is a prescription device that uses a software algorithm to analyze optical or other physical properties of a skin lesion and returns a classification of the skin lesion.  The device is intended for use by a physician not trained in the clinical diagnosis and management of skin cancer as an adjunctive second-read device following identification of a suspicious skin lesion.  It is not for use as a standalone diagnostic and is not for use to confirm a clinical diagnosis.

results.device_name: Software Controlled Endoscope And Instrument Holder
results.definition: To hold and position endoscopes and instruments.

results.device_name: Endoscopic Video Imaging System / Software Component For Real Time Video Augmentation
results.definition: To allow for visualization of body cavities through an endoscope with real time augmentation of video images via software to a monitor.

results.device_name: Pathology Software Algorithm Device Analyzing Digital Images For Cancer Prognosis
results.definition: A pathology software algorithm device analyzing digital images for cancer prognosis is a software intended to analyze scanned whole slide images (WSIs) from prostate biopsies prepared from formalin fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) tissue and stained using Hematoxylin & Eosin (H&E) stains.  The device provides prognostic risk estimates which are intended to assist physicians with prognostic risk-based decisions along with other clinicopathological factors. The device is not intended to determine a clinical diagnosis.

results.device_name: Hypertension Machine Learning-Based Notification Software
results.definition: Hypertension machine learning-based notification software employs machine learning techniques to suggest the likelihood of hypertension for further referral or diagnostic follow-up.

results.device_name: Ultrasound Imaging For Vascular Access For Hemodialysis
results.definition: Ultrasound imaging for vascular access for hemodialysis

results.device_name: Orthopedic Augmented Reality
results.definition: An orthopedic augmented reality device provides visual guidance during orthopedic procedures, where the use of stereotaxic navigation is utilized. Visual guidance is displayed as augmented reality stereoscopic images to intraoperatively augment the users field of view.

results.device_name: Adjunctive Hemodynamic Indicator With Decision Point For Military Use
results.definition: An adjunctive hemodynamic indicator with decision point is a device that identifies and monitors hemodynamic condition(s) of interest and provides notifications at a clinically meaningful decision point. This device is intended to be used adjunctively along with other monitoring and patient information. The device is intended for use by the Military.

results.device_name: Loss Of Pulse Notification Software
results.definition: A photoplethysmograph analysis software device for over-the-counter use analyzes photoplethysmograph data and provides information for identifying loss of pulse. This device is not intended to provide a diagnosis.

results.device_name: Software Device To Aid In The Prediction Or Diagnosis Of Sepsis
results.definition: A software device to aid in the prediction or diagnosis of sepsis uses advanced algorithms to analyze patient specific data to aid health care providers in the prediction and/or diagnosis of sepsis. The device is intended for adjunctive use and is not intended to be used as the sole determining factor in assessing a patient's sepsis status. The device may contain alarms that alert the care provider of the patient's status. The device is not intended to monitor response to treatment in patients being treated for sepsis.

results.device_name: Ear, Nose, And Throat Image Analyzer
results.definition: An ear, nose, and throat image analyzer is a device that uses software to analyze patient-specific optical images of the ear, nose, and throat area. The results are provided to healthcare providers as an aid to detection, diagnosis, or monitoring of ear, nose, and throat conditions.

results.device_name: Oct Imaging System With Ai/Ml Software For Adjunctive Detection Of Breast Cancer
results.definition: Intended as an adjunctive tool for intraoperative imaging and detection of cancer in breast tissue during excisional breast surgery (e.g., lumpectomy).

results.device_name: Radiology Software For Opportunistic Evaluation Of Low Bone Mineral Density
results.definition: This device is software which opportunistically assesses radiological images to estimate bone mineral density (BMD) intended to assist in a healthcare professional's decision to evaluate patients for possible low BMD within a bone health screening program. The software employs an algorithm that estimates  BMD using eligible radiological image data obtained for other clinical purposes.

results.device_name: Dental Image Analyzer
results.definition: A dental image analyzer is a prescription home use device that uses software intended to collect and analyze patient-specific, optical camera-based, intraoral images. The analyses are provided to dental health care professionals as an aid to diagnosis of oral health conditions and/or to monitor treatment progress.

results.device_name: Adjunctive Cardiac Amyloidosis Status Indicator
results.definition: The adjunctive cardiac amyloidosis status indicator is a prescription device based on sensor technology or image data to provide information to an interpreting clinician in detecting cardiac amyloidosis. This device is intended for adjunctive use with other physical vital sign parameters and patient information and is not intended to independently direct therapy.

results.device_name: Gastrointestinal Capsule Endoscopy Analysis Software Device
results.definition: A gastrointestinal capsule endoscopy analysis software device is used to analyze pre-recorded capsule endoscopy videos of the gastrointestinal tract that are suspected of containing lesions. This device uses software algorithms to identify images and areas of interest as outputs to aid the clinician in analyzing suspected lesions, for clinician review of device outputs. The device may contain hardware to support interfacing with a capsule imaging system.

results.device_name: Over-The-Counter Device To Assess Risk Of Sleep Apnea
results.definition: An over-the-counter device to assess risk of sleep apnea is intended to provide a notification of the risk of sleep apnea in users who have not been  previously diagnosed with sleep apnea. This device uses software algorithms to analyze input sensor signals and provide a risk assessment for sleep apnea. It is not intended to provide a standalone diagnosis, replace traditional methods of diagnosis (e.g., polysomnography), assist clinicians in diagnosing sleep disorders, or be used as an apnea monitor.

results.device_name: Pulmonary Hypertension Machine Learning-Based Notification Software
results.definition: Pulmonary hypertension machine learning-based notification software employs machine learning techniques to suggest the likelihood of pulmonary hypertension for further referral or diagnostic follow-up.

results.device_name: Home Monitoring Ophthalmic Optical Coherence Tomography (Oct) Imaging Device
results.definition: A home monitoring ophthalmic imaging device is a prescription self-imaging device that incorporates imaging system hardware and automated image processing and analysis to enable patients at home to provide measurements that are intended for use by a physician for monitoring ophthalmic diseases or conditions in between regularly scheduled assessments.
